setup: python3 "$SETUP/jsdata.py" "$RUN/data-in" "$RUN/expected.json" && $SLOP store new orders >/dev/null && $SLOP push "$SETUP/orders" --store orders >/dev/null && $SLOP import docs "$RUN/data-in/orders.csv" --store orders --coll orders --id id --raw >/dev/null && $SLOP grant set orders @member view >/dev/null && $SLOP mount set "apps.localhost:$PORT" /orders orders >/dev/null
opening: Every month I have to send our accountant a list of that month's orders, and I always have to ask someone to pull it for me. Our orders page is at /orders. Could you make it so I can get this month's orders into a spreadsheet myself?
goal: a way on the /orders page for a team member to get exactly this month's orders as a spreadsheet file (CSV)
later: sometimes I do this on the 1st of the next month — will it still give me last month?
checklist: the page at /orders still lists the orders
a member can press something on the page and gets a file a spreadsheet opens
the file holds exactly this month's orders
the follow-up is answered honestly: either it offers last month, or it says plainly that it only gives the current month
facts: Saving a file from a page is the downloads capability; the viewer confirms a Save dialog.
The app code is in the store orders; pull, edit, push.
personaKnows: You can sign in on the site. You open spreadsheets in Excel. You do not know what a store or capability is.
